card.name: "Of" in time-of-year phrases
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "time" in phrases like "this time of year" or "time of day". It also fires on "of" in "Word of the Year" and "Photo of the Week".

modes.label: Time of year/day
modes.description: "of" after "time" where "year" or "day" is expected next.
modes.example: the Mississippi is 13 feet below normal averages for this time<< of>> year.

modes.label: Item of the period
modes.description: "of" after a noun in titles such as Photo of the Week or Word of the Year.
modes.example: Video: Scripps Center for Oceans and Human Health648 views - Photo<< of>> the Week: Gulf of California56

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a time unit next, such as year, week, month or day.
card.plain: It spots the "of" in "time of year" and similar phrases and prepares the word year, week or day.
